column1: # title: Table 310.4(1) Conductor Applications and Insulations Rated 600 Volts
# note: Note: Conductors in Table 310.4(1) shall be permitted to be rated up to 1000 volts if listed and marked.
# note: ¹Outer coverings shall not be required where listed without a covering.
# note: ²Higher temperature rated constructions shall be permitted where design conditions require maximum conductor operating temperatures above 90°C (194°F).
# note: ³Conductor sizes shall be permitted for signaling circuits permitting 300-volt insulation.
# note: ⁴The ampacity of Type UF cable shall be limited in accordance with 340.80.
# note: ⁵Type UF insulation thickness shall include the integral jacket.

# note: ⁶Insulation thickness shall be permitted to be 2.03 mm (80 mils) for listed Type USE conductors that have been subjected to special investigations. The nonmetallic covering over individual rubber-covered conductors of aluminum-sheathed cable and of lead-sheathed or multiconductor cable shall not be required to be flame retardant.
